scenarios.scenario: Switch between adjacent document tabs using the keyboard

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open as adjacent tabs in that order
the first document tab is active
the user presses Control+Tab
the next document tab becomes active
its model browser and viewport are displayed
the first document remains open
the user presses Control+Shift+Tab
the first document tab becomes active again
the next document remains open

scenarios.scenario: Inspect a document tab's context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` is open and active
the user opens the document tab's context menu
the menu offers Close, Close Tabs, Close All, Save and Properties
it displays shortcuts for Close and Save
the user dismisses the menu
the document remains active

scenarios.scenario: Hide and restore the document tab strip

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open
document tabs are visible
the user clears Document Tabs in the View tab's User Interface menu
the document tab strip disappears
the active document remains displayed
Document Tabs is unchecked in the User Interface menu
the user selects Document Tabs in the same menu
the document tab strip reappears
Document Tabs is checked in the User Interface menu
the open documents are available as tabs

scenarios.scenario: Open the extended window list when tabs are hidden

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open
document tabs are hidden
the user opens the Switch menu on the View tab
the menu lists open windows and offers More Windows
the user chooses More Windows
a Select Window dialog displays a scrollable list of open documents
the dialog offers OK and cancels

scenarios.scenario: Switch to the neighboring part with the keyboard

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open as neighboring tabs in that order
the left-hand part is active
the user presses Control+Tab
the right-hand part becomes active
its model browser and viewport are displayed
the left-hand part remains open

scenarios.scenario: Inspect properties of an inactive document from its tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open in that order
the first part is active
the second part has been saved
the user opens the second part's document tab context menu
the first part remains active in the workspace
the user chooses Properties from the context menu
the properties dialog identifies the second part
its General page displays the file name, location, size and timestamps
the user closes the properties dialog without making changes
the first part remains active in the workspace
the second part remains open

scenarios.scenario: Close a saved inactive document with its tab close button

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open in that order
the first part is active
the second part is saved and has no unsaved changes
the user clicks the close button on the second part's document tab
the second part's tab disappears
the first part remains active in the workspace
no save prompt is displayed

scenarios.scenario: Close a newly created empty active part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open
PartOne is active
the user creates a new empty part from a standard metric template
the new part becomes active and has its own document tab
the user clicks the close button on the new part's tab without editing it
the new part's tab disappears without a save prompt
the previously active part is displayed again
its model browser and viewport are restored

scenarios.scenario: Close an inactive saved document from its tab menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open in that order
the first part is active
the second part is saved and has no unsaved changes
the user opens the second part's document tab context menu
the user chooses Close
the second part's tab disappears
the first part remains active in the workspace
no save prompt is displayed
